# tpuf_namespace (Data Source)

Looks up an existing turbopuffer namespace's schema and metadata.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tpuf_namespace" "docs" {
  name = "docs"
}

output "docs_schema" {
  value = data.tpuf_namespace.docs.schema
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The namespace name.

### Read-Only

- `approx_row_count` (Number) Approximate number of rows currently in the namespace.
- `pinning_replicas` (Number) Number of warm read replicas pinned for this namespace.
- `schema` (Attributes Map) Attribute schema for documents in this namespace, keyed by attribute name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schema))

<a id="nestedatt--schema"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schema`

Read-Only:

- `ann` (Boolean) Whether an approximate nearest neighbor index is built for the attribute.
- `filterable` (Boolean) Whether the attribute can be used in filters.
- `full_text_search` (Boolean) Whether the attribute is indexed for BM25 full-text search.
- `glob` (Boolean) Whether glob filters are enabled on the attribute.
- `regex` (Boolean) Whether regex filters are enabled on the attribute.
- `type` (String) Attribute data type, e.g. string, int, bool, [1536]f32.
